observations: Photo 0: A black/grey mirrorless-style camera body with a zoom lens attached, shot on a blue velvet backdrop with a watermark overlay.
Photo 0: Text on the body reads 'LUMIX' and a single letter 'G' is visible on the hand-grip badge; no full model number (e.g. 'G7') is legible.
Photo 1: Rear view shows the flip-out LCD screen open and displaying 'Please set the clock' / 'Clock Set' - indicating the camera powers on.
Photo 1: One battery pack (labelled 'LUMIX') and one charger cradle are visible side-by-side; only a single battery is shown despite the claim of two.
No shots of the lens mount contacts, sensor, memory card slot, ports, or any accessory box/strap.
No visible physical damage, but image resolution and lighting (blue gel) make fine scratches or dents hard to judge.

identity.kind: mirrorless camera (Panasonic Lumix G-series, exact model unconfirmed)
read_from: photo 0 body badge shows 'LUMIX' and 'G' only

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'LUMIX' and 'G' but no visible '7' or full model plate; model number not confirmed in any photo.
Lighting and watermark obscure fine condition details; no close-up of body wear, lens glass, or sensor.
Photo 1 shows only one battery pack and one charger; a second battery is not visible in either photo.
Photo 1 shows a power-on screen prompting clock set, which suggests it turns on, but no shutter-count, image capture, or lens autofocus test is shown.

risks.risk: Exact model (G7 vs similar Lumix G variant) drastically affects price.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model nameplate/badge on the top or front of the body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/base Lumix G-series body, not the higher-value G7

risks.risk: Sensor dust, shutter wear, or hidden fault not shown by a single clock-set screen.
risks.proof: Short video of camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying it on the LCD; menu screen showing shutter count if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not fully verified working (worst case: non-functional)

risks.risk: Lens (autofocus, aperture blades, zoom ring) condition unknown.
risks.proof: Video of lens zooming, autofocusing, and aperture blades opening/closing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Only one battery visible despite claim of two.
risks.proof: Photo showing both batteries together, each with visible charge indicator or being inserted.

risks.risk: Battery health/cycle count and charger compatibility unverified.
risks.proof: Photo of battery charge percentage on camera screen or charger LED status.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery health unknown (worst case: degraded)

risks.risk: Missing accessories (memory card, strap, box, cables) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens + single battery + charger only, no extras

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the model nameplate/badge confirming 'G7' or exact model.
Photo or video showing both batteries together with the charger.
Short video: power on, take a test shot, show it on screen, and zoom/focus the lens.
Photo of the lens mount and rear element for scratches/fungus.
Photo of the memory card slot and ports (HDMI/USB) area.
response.reason: The model number that drives the price (claimed G7) is not legible in either photo, and the accessory claim of two batteries is contradicted by photo 1 showing only one, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clearer model shot.
